name: East Riding of Yorkshire (United Kingdom)

colors.symbolism: the sea and the Wolds sky

description: A field divided vertically blue and green, charged at the centre with a large white rose of Yorkshire.
history: Registered with the Flag Institute in 2013 after a design competition; blue for the sea and the Humber, green for the farmland of the Wolds and Holderness.

features.symbolism: the white rose of the House of York
